_doc: The source of the shipped sound library (static/audio/library/). tools/build_sound_library.py reads this,
generates only the entries whose file is missing (ElevenLabs, once, on 5th Corner's account — Matt,
2026-09-25: 'precache them FROM my 11 labs and ship precached whatever you need'), processes each one
(trim, loudness, mono/stereo, mp3) and writes the files and catalog.json. The game never reads this file;
it reads the catalog. `prompt` is the words, the lane's `suffix` is appended when it is sent, and the
catalog records the whole thing. `tags` are matched against what the player did or sees (sound_library.pick);
`where` only against the place, so it can choose between clips but never pick one on its own.
`source: stock:<file>` imports a clip already generated (assets/music/stock in the Dev tree) instead of

ambience.suffix: Seamless looping ambience, steady from start to end. No music, no melody, no voices.

foley.suffix: Close-mic foley, dry and real, one take with a clear start and a natural end. No music, no voice.

consequence.suffix: Cinematic sound design, one continuous take that builds and dies away. No music, no melody, no voice.

music.suffix: Instrumental only: no vocals, no choir, no lyrics. A steady, loopable texture with no intro and no ending.

Open high desert in daytime: dry wind hissing over sand and sagebrush, grit ticking against rock, a vast empty stillness underneath.
High desert at night: sparse crickets and night insects, a cold low wind moving over scrub brush, huge empty stillness.
A perimeter fence at night: chain-link rattling softly in gusts of wind, the electric buzz of a sodium floodlight, a diesel generator droning in the distance.
Outside a sealed industrial facility: a distant generator drone, transformer hum, wind moving across concrete, a loose metal sign tapping against a post.
An empty institutional corridor: fluorescent tubes buzzing and flickering overhead, air-handling hum through ceiling vents, a hard sterile silence.
A server room: dense cooling-fan roar of rack-mounted computers, hard drives clicking, air conditioning droning.
A concrete corridor in lockdown: a klaxon alarm whooping from a distant room, the hum of red emergency lights, ventilation roaring.
A sterile laboratory at night: refrigerator compressors humming, a slow drip into a steel sink, faint electronic equipment whine.
Heavy rain drumming on a corrugated sheet-metal roof, gutters overflowing, water splashing onto concrete below.
Inside an old jeep with the engine idling: a low engine rumble through the cab, a dashboard rattling, wind pushing against the windows.
A campfire at night in the desert: burning wood crackling, embers popping, a low night wind, sparse crickets.
A neon megacity street at night in the rain: rain hissing on wet pavement, the electrical buzz of neon signs, distant sirens, a low droning hum of traffic overhead.
A narrow back alley in a future city: transformer hum, pipes dripping, steam venting from a street grate, a distant machinery pulse.
An underground pump station: big water pumps churning, pipes gurgling and knocking, water trickling across a concrete floor.
A chemical plant: thick liquid bubbling in open vats, steam valves hissing, an electrical hum, a distant metal groan.
A sewer tunnel: water flowing along a brick channel, echoing drips, the far-off scurry of rats.
A deep underground bunker: a low ventilation drone, distant metallic creaks and pings inside the walls, oppressive pressure.
A desert oilfield: a pump jack creaking through a slow rhythmic cycle, a diesel engine chugging, dry wind across the pad.
Urban unrest a few blocks away: sirens wailing, a helicopter circling overhead, an indistinct crowd roar far off with no intelligible words.
Something alive inside the walls: a wet organic pulsing, a low resonant drone, slow squelching and dripping, like breathing inside flesh.
An old mine shaft: wind moaning down the shaft, timber supports creaking, water dripping into puddles, loose stones settling far away.
An abandoned house: wind whistling through broken windows, floorboards and walls creaking as the house settles, a loose shutter tapping.
An empty 1990s office after hours: fluorescent hum, air-conditioning hiss, a wall clock ticking, a CRT monitor whining, an elevator far off.
A radio room: a shortwave receiver hissing with drifting static, the faint electrical hum of old valve equipment.
A pine forest by day: wind moving through tall pines, branches creaking, a few distant birds.
A vast empty hangar: a huge reverberant space, wind leaking through high gaps, distant metal pinging as it cools, pigeons shifting in the rafters.
Footsteps: work boots walking steadily on loose gravel and dirt.
Footsteps: heavy boots crunching over dry gravel and packed dirt at a steady walking pace.
Footsteps: boots walking across a metal grating catwalk, hollow clanging steps with a slight ring.
Footsteps: hard-soled shoes walking down a tiled corridor, each step echoing.
Footsteps: boots walking on a gritty concrete floor, scuffing, with a little room echo.
Wading steps through ankle-deep water, splashing and sloshing with each stride.
Sprinting footsteps on gravel and dirt, fast and heavy, gear jostling.
A person running hard across rocky dirt ground, rapid crunching footfalls.
Running hard across a metal catwalk: rapid clanging footsteps on steel grating.
Running footsteps echoing down a long concrete corridor, fast and urgent.
Crawling on hands and knees across a gritty floor, fabric scraping, gear dragging.
Sliding feet-first across dusty ground, grit and small stones scraping under the body.
Jumping and landing hard on both feet: a heavy thud and a rattle of gear.
Vaulting over a metal railing: hands slapping the steel, a quick scuffle and a landing on the far side.
Vaulting over a low obstacle: a grunt-free scramble of hands and boots on metal, then a firm landing.
Climbing a chain-link fence: the wire mesh rattling and shaking, boots scraping, a jump down at the top.
Climbing a metal ladder: boots and gloved hands on steel rungs, a faint ring with each step.
Scrambling up a slope of loose rocks: stones sliding and clattering, boots slipping on scree.
Diving to the ground and rolling: a body thump, cloth scraping, a quick recovery.
A person's body collapsing onto a hard floor: a heavy dull thud and gear clattering.
Two bodies colliding hard in a tackle: clothing, a heavy impact, gear clattering.
Opening an old wooden door: a latch click and a slow creak of the hinges.
A door slowly creaking open: a long eerie hinge squeal that stops short.
Kicking a door open: a hard boot impact, the frame splintering, the door banging against the wall.
A wooden door kicked in: a loud crash and a splintering crack, the door slamming back against the wall.
Rattling the handle of a locked door: the latch catching, the door shaking in its frame but not opening.
A heavy steel door slammed shut with a booming echo.
A massive blast door grinding open on hydraulics: a deep mechanical groan, the hiss of pressure releasing.
Swinging open a chain-link gate: rattling wire mesh and a squealing hinge.
Opening a heavy metal hatch: hinges groaning, then a clank as it drops open.
A metal locker door yanked open with a tinny rattle and bang.
Pulling open a desk drawer: the runners scraping and the contents sliding and rattling.
Pressing keypad buttons: electronic beeps, then an access-granted chirp and the clunk of a lock releasing.
Prying something open with a crowbar: metal straining and creaking, then a sharp pop.
A hard boot kick against an empty metal barrel: a hollow clang that rings out.
Kicking a steel panel hard: a flat metallic bang and a short rattle.
Kicking loose debris aside: rubble, scrap and junk scattering across a concrete floor.
A heavy boot stomp: a hard slam onto the floor with a crunch of grit.
A punch landing on a body: a meaty thump and a rustle of clothing.
A pane of glass smashed: a sharp shatter and shards tinkling onto the floor.
Breaking a window with a heavy object: glass bursting and a spray of shards falling.
Smashing a computer console with a pipe: plastic cracking, a glass screen shattering, electric sparks fizzing.
A wooden crate smashed apart: planks splintering and cracking.
A shoulder slamming against a steel door: a deep boom and a rattle of the frame.
A steel pipe striking a metal beam: a hard, ringing clang.
A baton whipping through the air and cracking against body armor.
A heavy blade whooshing through the air in one fast swing.
A knife slicing through rope and canvas: a sharp tearing cut.
An electrical short circuit: a crackling arc, sparks spitting, a fizzing buzz that cuts out.
Tearing a sheet of metal loose: screeching, wrenching and a final snap.
Shoving a heavy crate across a concrete floor: a long grinding scrape.
Dragging a heavy weight across a floor: cloth and boots scraping and scuffing.
A heap of rubble collapsing: rocks and broken concrete tumbling and crashing down, dust settling.
Turning a rusted valve wheel: metal squealing through a half turn, then a hiss of pressure.
A burst of hot steam hissing violently from a broken pipe.
Jumping into water: a heavy splash and water slapping back.
A breaker switch thrown: a heavy thunk and an electrical hum rising as the power comes on.
A single pistol gunshot outdoors: a sharp crack with a short echo.
A single loud rifle gunshot: a sharp explosive crack and a long rolling echo across open desert.
Racking a pistol slide and checking the magazine: crisp metallic clicks.
A stun gun fired: a loud harsh crackling electric buzz with snapping sparks, about one second.
A nearby explosion: a heavy boom, then debris raining down.
A metal object thrown hard: a short whoosh through the air, then it clatters and bounces across a concrete floor.
A 35mm film camera shutter firing: a crisp mechanical click and snap.
Winding a film camera's advance lever: a quick ratcheting click-click.
An old camera flash charging with a rising whine, then popping.
Picking up a small object from a metal table: a light scrape and a soft handling sound.
Lifting a heavy steel wrench off a concrete floor: a metallic scrape and a ringing clank.
A zipper pulled open along a canvas backpack: one long bright zip, then fabric rustling as something is stuffed inside.
Strapping on body armor: velcro tearing and buckles clicking shut.
Rifling through a stack of paper documents: pages rustling and flipping.
Opening an old leather-bound journal: the spine creaking and pages turning.
A metal flashlight switched on with a firm click.
A handheld walkie-talkie: a squelch, crackle and a burst of static, no words.
Fast typing on an old mechanical computer keyboard, clacking keys and a short beep.
A ring of keys jingling, then a key turned in a lock with a click.
A shovel digging into dry dirt: a scrape, a lift and the dirt tossed aside.
Rummaging through a box of junk: objects clattering and shifting.
Plugging a heavy connector into a socket: a firm click and a short electronic chirp.
Opening and slamming the door of an old jeep: a metal latch and a solid thunk.
An old jeep engine cranking, catching and idling roughly.
Close-up heavy breathing, panting after running, no words.
A pounding heartbeat, low and muffled, as if heard from inside the chest.
Clothing rustling as someone crouches and shifts their weight.
A low inhuman growl rumbling from something unseen.
A wet squelch of organic tissue tearing apart.
A slow swell of dread: a deep sub rumble rising with scraping metallic textures and a distant groan, then receding.
A sudden danger hit: a sharp metallic impact and whoosh, then a high ringing tension that fades.
A discovery: a clearly audible shimmering resonance, like a struck metal bowl, swelling over a warm low hum, eerie and wondrous, then slowly fading.
Tension releasing: air rushing out of a sealed room, a low warm drone settling into quiet, wind outside.
An eerie drone: a thin wavering electrical tone over a low hum, distant metal creaking, a faint breath of wind.
The aftermath of a crash: debris settling, small stones and glass trickling, hot metal ticking as it cools, dust.
A heavy explosion and its aftermath: a deep boom, a rolling echo, debris raining down, ears ringing.
A chase: fast footsteps pounding away, gear rattling, a racing heartbeat pulse underneath.
A violent struggle: scuffling boots, heavy thuds of bodies and fists, gear clattering, then sudden stillness.
Power dying: an electrical whine winding down, sparks crackling, fluorescent lights buzzing out one by one, then darkness.
A huge machine grinding to life: heavy gears engaging, a low rumble building into a steady mechanical roar.
A structure giving way: steel groaning and buckling, concrete cracking, then a roaring collapse and falling debris.
Water bursting free: a pipe rupturing and water flooding across a concrete floor, rushing and splashing.
An alarm triggered: a klaxon starting to wail and echoing through concrete halls, a warning buzzer pulsing.
Something moves in the dark: a wet slithering, a low guttural rasp, claws scraping on metal, then it is gone.
A burst of gunfire: several rifle shots ringing out and echoing off buildings, brass casings tinkling.
A heavy door forced open: metal screeching, a lock snapping, the door grinding wide and banging against a wall.
Falling: a rush of air, cloth flapping, a heavy impact far below that echoes.
Fire spreading: flames roaring and crackling, wood popping, a whoosh as something catches.
A violent electric shock: a loud buzzing arc, crackling sparks, a sharp snap.
